purpose: Teach: それ程/くるくる/エライ/終われ/あたたかい/はっと/通り越し/飛び出す

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、今日のお客様は、それ程多くなかったね、メイちゃん
lines.en: You know, it wasn't too crowded with customers today, was it?
lines.style: Soft, observational opening. Gentle pace, almost thinking aloud. Warm and inclusive—inviting Aoi to share the moment rather than declaring it.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、コーヒーカップをくるくる回してらしたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: I noticed one customer was spinning their coffee cup around the whole time.
lines.style: Quiet, noticing tone. Slight pause before 'spinning' — catching the small detail. Gentle and amused, not critical. Trailing warmth.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、新人さんがエライ頑張りやさんだね、メイちゃん
lines.en: That new person really threw themselves into the work today, didn't they?
lines.style: Approving, genuine praise. Light lift on 'really.' Warm recognition without overdoing it. Sincere and direct, the way you speak about someone you respect.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、忙しい時、なかなか仕事が終われないわね、メイちゃん
lines.en: But when it does get busy, it's hard to wrap everything up on time.
lines.style: Acknowledging, realistic. Slight sigh beneath the words. Not complaining—just naming the truth gently. Understanding fatigue without dwelling on it.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様のあたたかい一言が、励みになるね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Still, a kind word from a customer really does lift you up, doesn't it?
lines.style: Tender and knowing. Slower pace on 'kind word.' Soft conviction—speaking from experience. The warmth of someone who notices what keeps others going.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、新メニュー、お客様、はっと驚かれたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: The new menu surprised people — I could see it in their faces.
lines.style: Pleased, almost delighted. Crisp attack on 'surprised.' Light, uplifted tone. Genuine satisfaction in a small win. Slight lean forward in the voice.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、お席を通り越して別の席に座られたわ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Though one customer almost walked past their table entirely — they were so caught off guard.
lines.style: Gently wry, amused. Light, knowing tone. Not mocking—warmly teasing the absurdity. Slight laugh beneath the words.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、新メニューが好評で、お店から飛び出す思いだったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Honestly, the new menu had me so happy I felt like I could burst right out of the shop.
lines.style: Animated, energetic lift throughout. Quick pace, genuine excitement. Open, unguarded joy breaking through. Bright finish—not contained.
